TEXT:
On my way home from school, I came across the 
sight of Sena loitering around a park bench.
What's she doing alone in a place like this...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, good work today.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ah, Kousaka-senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's up? You were so energetic earlier...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ahaha...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...We still didn't come to a decision after that 
meeting.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Is that what you are brooding over?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Well, something like that. Lately, things haven't been 
going as planned... so that's...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Not going as planned?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Yes... In that meeting, everyone just did as they 
pleased, and the meeting was over before we 
could even decide anything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I am supposed to take charge and keep them 
focused during the meeting, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Since everyone is accepting of one another there, I 
ended up derailing the meeting by talking about 
my interests... This isn't good, is it?

Ah right, when she first joined the club, she was still 
hiding the fact that she's a fujoshi.

But because it was no longer necessary to hide it, 
she has been immersed in her delusions more often 
lately in front of us without discretion.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, you're the type that wants everything to be 
done properly, so you would be bothered by that, 
but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Don't you think that being able to talk about your 
hobbies freely is a good thing?

Just like when Kirino, Kuroneko, and Saori are 
together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
The others will probably forget all about it after a 
night's sleep. Don't worry about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Is... that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
If you're still bothered by it, just try harder next 
time, got it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Okay. Thank you.

Great, looks like she's feeling better. Now I can go 
home in relief.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then, I'll see you later.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: U-Um... Kousaka-senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Um...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Life counseling...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Could you give me some... [font_size=28]life counseling?[/font_size]

Hey now, you kidding me? I never imagined that a 
day would come where I would have life 
counseling with someone else's little sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Um, is something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...No, it's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Does this mean... no?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Sure, I'm free anyway. Wanna go somewhere else?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Ah, no! Here is fine. Even though I said life 
counseling, it's not a topic that's serious...

Thank goodness... compared to Kirino's life 
counseling, this might be a breeze.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Besides, of all the people I know, you're the only 
person that understands this topic the most.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You think way too highly of me.

She doesn't mean any harm but, that's a bit of 
pressure on me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So? What's the problem?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: The truth is...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [font_size=28]I find Onii-chan creepy.[/font_size]
...I tested this out by calling Akagi then and there.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Hey, what's up Kousaka?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, what do you think of your little sister?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
She's practically an angel! Why, you ask? It'll take 3 
hours to explain, but that's not a problem, huh? I'll 
start with when she was first born...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...No doubt, he is creepy.
Sena dropped her shoulders in disappointment.
